# Increment

> Increment is an open-source Python library for warehouse-native A/B testing, causal inference, and experiment analysis.

Analyze randomized experiments from dataframes or SQL warehouses, or
observational treatments from dataframes. Increment supports CUPED, power
analysis, MDE, sequential and always-valid inference, SRM diagnostics, IPTW,
DML, AIPW, encouragement designs, and heterogeneous treatment effects.

It does not assign traffic, manage feature flags, ingest events, or maintain a
separate event store.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kylejcaron/increment/main/README.md): Project overview and installation.
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kylejcaron/increment/main/docs/guides/quickstart.md): Analyze A/B tests from Python dataframes.
- [Method selection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kylejcaron/increment/main/docs/guides/choose-a-method.md): Choose a design and estimator from the treatment process and analysis goal.
- [Data model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kylejcaron/increment/main/docs/guides/data-model.md): Declare warehouse sources, exposures, metrics, and experiments.
- [Observational causal inference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kylejcaron/increment/main/docs/guides/observational.md): Use IPTW, DML, and AIPW with explicit causal assumptions.
- [CUPED](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kylejcaron/increment/main/docs/guides/cuped.md): Reduce variance with pre-treatment data.
- [Power analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kylejcaron/increment/main/docs/guides/power-analysis.md): Calculate sample size, power, and MDE.
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kylejcaron/increment/main/docs/api.md): Public Python API.
